data.title: 信浓 · 月下寝殿的半透晨袍
data.description: 静谧的重樱寝殿内，清辉如水洒落在雕花木柱与席垫上。信浓端坐在软垫中央，半透天青丝绸睡袍轻滑而落，露出如雪般无瑕的香肩与锁骨。九条蓬松如云的雪白狐尾在身后舒展环绕，金色的兽瞳中泛着梦醒时的迷离光泽，气质出尘而又带着摄人心魄的诱惑。
data.location: moonlit traditional bedchamber with sliding shoji doors
data.action: sitting gracefully on plush floor cushion, sheer cyan silk peignoir sliding off shoulder, nine fluffy white fox tails gently fanned out, glowing golden eyes, elegant alluring pose
data.lighting: ethereal silver moonlight illuminating sheer silk fabric and white fur
data.mood: dreamlike mystical allure, majestic quiet intimacy
data.promptProse: Seated upon a silk floor cushion in an ornate moonlit chamber, Shinano wears a translucent cyan nightgown slipping gently off her shoulders. Nine massive white fox tails drape around her as her golden eyes gleam softly.
data.animaCaption: Shinano in a sheer blue nightgown surrounded by nine white fox tails under ethereal moonlight.
